description: This Java class implements a Data Access Object (DAO) for NotificationTemplate entities, providing methods for querying, counting, and deleting notification templates in a SQL database, using Spring Data JPA.

classes.name: JpaNotificationTemplateDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing NotificationTemplate entities in a SQL database, implementing methods for CRUD operations and queries based on tenant ID, notification types, and pagination.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of NotificationTemplateEntity.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndNotificationTypesAndPageLink
methods.description: Finds notification templates by tenant ID and notification types with pagination.

methods.name: countByTenantIdAndNotificationTypes
methods.description: Counts notification templates by tenant ID and notification types.

methods.name: removeByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes notification templates by tenant ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndExternalId
methods.description: Finds a notification template by tenant ID and external UUID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a notification template by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds notification templates by tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for a given internal notification template ID.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Finds all notification templates for a tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the JPA repository used for NotificationTemplateEntity.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE.
